THE NOTICE TO RECTIFY THE EXTRAORDINARY GAZETTE OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALISTREPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA BEARING NO. 2129/95 DATED 28TH JUNE, 2019

I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, by virtue of the powers vested in me underthe Urban Development Authority Law, No. 41 of 1978 as amended, do hereby rectify the Extraordinary Gazette Notificationbearing No. 2129/95 dated 28th June, 2019 (07-4554/6).
The caption of the upper part of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification “AND MAGALLE PRADESHIYA SABHA”Shall be deleted.
The word “AND” shall be inserted immediately after “BOPE PODDALA PRADESHIYA SABHA (PART)”.
The content of the upper part of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification shall be rectified by repealing “MagallePradeshiya Sabha” as being part of the Greater Galle Urban Development Area.
The word “had” in the fourth line of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification shall be substituted with “have.”
The rectifications introduced to the upper part of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification shall be read as follows;

“NOTICE OF APPROVAL OF THE DEVELOPMENT PLAN FOR THE GREATER GALLE URBAN DEVELOPMENT AREACOMPRISING OF GALLE MUNICIPAL COUNCIL, AKMEEMANA PRADESHIYA SABHA (PART), BOPE PODDALAPRADESHIYA SABHA (PART) AND HABARADUWA PRADESHIYA SABHA (PART) AREAS.”

“NOTICE is hereby given to the General Public of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka under Section 8G of theUrban Development Authority Law, No. 41 of 1978 as amended from time to time that I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, theMinister in charge of the subject of Megapolis and Western Development, by virtue of the powers vested in me underSection 8F of the said Law, have approved the Development Plan on the 28th day of June, 2019 for the Greater GalleUrban Development Area comprising of the Galle Municipal Council, Akmeemana Pradeshiya Sabha (Part), BopePoddala Pradeshiya Sabha (Part) and Habaraduwa Pradeshiya Sabha (Part) areas, prepared under Section 8A of thesaid Law.”
PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA,Minister of Megapolis and Western Development.
07th November, 2019.
The caption of the latter part of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification “Magalle Pradeshiya Sabha” shall be deleted.
The word “and” shall be inserted immediately after “Bope Poddala Pradeshiya Sabha (Part)”.
In the content of the latter part of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification the word “(Amendment)” in the second lineshall be substituted with “Law, No. 41 of 1978 as amended by the”.
The content of the latter part of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification shall be rectified by repealing “MagallePradeshiya Sabha” as being part of the Greater Galle Urban Development Area.
The word “have”in the fourth line of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification shall be substituted with “has”.
The word “Amendment Act” given in the last line of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification shall be substituted with“amended Law”.
The rectifications introduced to the latter part of the said Extraordinary Gazette Notification shall be read as follows;.

“Approval of the Development Plan for the Greater Galle Urban Development Area comprising of Galle MunicipalCouncil, Akmeemana Pradeshiya Sabha (Part), Bope Poddala Pradeshiya Sabha (Part) and Habaraduwa PradeshiyaSabha (Part) Areas.”

“Public are hereby informed that the Development Plan prepared under Section 8A of the Urban Development AuthorityLaw, No. 41 of 1978 as amended by the Act, No. 4 of 1982, for the Greater Galle Urban Development Area comprising ofGalle Municipal Council, Akmeemana Pradeshiya Sabha (Part), Bope Poddala Pradeshiya Sabha (Part) and HabaraduwaPradeshiya Sabha (part) areas has been approved on 28th June, 2019, by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister ofMegapolis and Western Development, by virtue of the powers vested in him under Section 8F of the said amended Law.”
DR. JAGATH MUNASINGHE,Chairman,Urban Development Authority.07th November, 2019,

Notwithstanding the provisions contained in the antecedent Gazette Notification bearing No. 2129/95 dated 28th June,2019 (07-4554/6), the rectification hereinbefore mentioned shall have retrospective effect and shall be deemed to havecome into operation on the 28th day of June, 2019.
PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA,Minister of Megapolis and Western Development.
07th November, 2019.
